name: Chemical Process & Exothermic CSTR Reaction Package
description: Continuous chemical synthesis plant with raw material charge pump, reactant feed preheater, jacket-cooled CSTR with Arrhenius exothermic kinetics, volatile fractionator/degasser separator, and unreacted feed recycle loop.
author: NebuDCS Standard Library
thermodynamic_requirements: Arrhenius Reaction Kinetics (k = A * exp(-Ea / RT))
Exothermic Heat of Reaction Release Coupling
control_strategies: TIC-401 Exothermic Reactor Temperature Control via Cooling Water Jacket Valve
LIC-401 Reactor Level Regulation via Bottoms Effluent Valve
FIC-401 Fresh Reactant Feed Pacing Control
High-Temperature Runaway Emergency Interlock (Trip Feed, Flood Coolant)
validation_rules: VLD-CHM01: Exothermic reactor must have active heat removal mechanism (jacket or internal coils)
VLD-CHM02: Reactor recycle stream must connect to feed mixer or pump suction prior to preheater
